_about: SADI protocol test vectors, one set per firmware/DLL version. Primary target is v1_003_mom (the lab board). Generated by gen_vectors.py from static analysis; see docs/protocol.md.

ftdi.baud_rate: not set by DLL (parallel 245 FIFO; no UART framing)

host_to_device.name: start_default_ranges
host_to_device.note: momLab_Start -> sendStart @0x6d882d80; bytes [2..5] = adcRange[0..3] (default 1 = +-5.12V set by connectSADI)

host_to_device.name: start_mixed_ranges
host_to_device.note: ch0 +-10.24, ch1 0..10.24, ch2 +-0.64, ch3 0..1.28 (all codes accepted by setAdcRange mask 0x88ef)

device_to_host.name: boot_or_query_reply_fw_1_003_state_booted
device_to_host.note: Emitted by firmware @0x4c2 right after boot and in reply to cmd 4 (query). DLL getPacket type 4 branch @0x6d882a7f: fw = BE16[8..9] + BE16[10..11]/1000

device_to_host.name: query_reply_while_running
device_to_host.note: Query is answered with the current state byte; msg_count bytes are always 0 in this packet type.

device_to_host.name: stop_ack
device_to_host.note: Firmware @0x67e: 55 02 <state> 00 + 604 zero bytes + tail. DLL treats any type other than 4/5 as state-only and sets SADI.state = byte[2].

device_to_host.name: data_packet_ranges_1_1_1_1
device_to_host.note: Layout per DLL getPacket @0x6d8828f6 loop: for k in 0..49, payload[12k..12k+3] = int32 LE encoder, then 4 x uint16 BE ADC. Firmware emits exactly this order (ISR @0x79c phases 0/1/2). volts_dll reproduces the DLL arithmetic including its quirks (raw 0x0000 maps to +FS on bipolar ranges; unipolar codes >= 0x8000 go negative). volts_ideal is the ADS8688 datasheet conversion.

device_to_host.name: data_packet_ranges_0_5_11_15
device_to_host.note: Same raw samples decoded with mixed ranges; the host must remember the ranges it sent in the Start packet, the device never echoes them.

framing_cases.name: leading_junk_then_packet
framing_cases.note: getPacket scans for 0x55 at i and requires tail AA 55 AA 55 at i+608..i+611 (tailCheck @0x6d883250); bytes before the match are dropped, bytes after the packet are kept for the next call.

framing_cases.name: truncated_data_packet_then_stop_ack
framing_cases.note: Happens when Stop lands mid-packet: firmware stops TCD1 immediately and sends the ack; the partial data packet has no tail and is skipped by the resync scan.

framing_cases.name: two_back_to_back_packets
framing_cases.note: DLL consumes exactly one packet per momLab_Read call; the remainder is memmoved to the ring start.

framing_cases.name: not_enough_bytes
framing_cases.note: getPacket returns -5 when fewer than 612 bytes are buffered (cmp eax,0x263; jle @0x6d882706).

framing_cases.name: bad_tail_rejected
framing_cases.note: Only the 4 tail bytes are validated; there is no checksum or CRC anywhere in the protocol.

v1_003_mom._about: Unit-test vectors for the SADI MOM (OOTB Electronics, FW 1.003 / momLab.dll 1.003) USB FIFO protocol. Generated by gen_vectors.py from the disassembly of momLab.dll and SADI_MOM_v1.003.hex; see docs/protocol.md for the derivation and confidence levels. All byte strings are lowercase hex with no separators. Multi-byte integers: encoder and msg_count are little-endian; ADC words and version halves are big-endian.

v3_41_generic._about: Firmware SADI-3.41HS.hex with SADI_FW3.dll (DLL version 3.021). Secondary target; see protocol.md section 8. CRC = CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over all preceding bytes, big-endian.

constants.fw_version_encoding: IEEE-754 float32 little-endian at bytes 2..5 of the 0xF6 packet

adc_ranges.meaning: OFF (convertToVoltage returns 0.0; firmware remap gives ADS8688 code 0)

host_to_device.name: requestReady
host_to_device.note: requestReady_LV @0x653023a0; firmware 0x94 handler replies 0xF6 version packet

host_to_device.name: requestInfo
host_to_device.note: requestInfo_LV @0x65302760; opcode 0x92 is NOT in the v3.41 firmware dispatch table (ignored)

host_to_device.name: sendReset
host_to_device.note: sendReset_LV @0x653025f0; firmware: software reset, no reply

host_to_device.name: sendStart
host_to_device.note: sendStart_LV @0x65302680; firmware replies 55 F2 F4 01 crc

host_to_device.name: sendStop
host_to_device.note: sendStop_LV @0x653026f0; firmware replies 55 F2 F5 01 crc then watchdog-resets itself

host_to_device.name: sendPredefInit_MOM_1000Hz
host_to_device.note: sendPredefInit_LV @0x65302530: [2..3] loop freq LE, [4..5] selection LE (2 pendulum, 3 MOM), [6..9] vendor range codes

host_to_device.name: sendWrite_MOM_dir0_512
host_to_device.note: sendWrite_LV mode 2/3 @0x653027d0: [2] 0, [3] motorDir, [4..5] value LE (firmware clamps to 0x3FF, writes TCC1 CCA/CCB)

device_to_host.name: version_reply_3_41
device_to_host.note: firmware constant bytes 71 3D 5A 40 @0x2616; DLL infoHandler sets state Ready only if state was Opened

device_to_host.name: data_packet_mode1_ranges_1_2_9_12
device_to_host.note: Firmware ISR @0xe22 layout: [2..9] ADC u16 LE x4, [10..13] enc0 i32 LE, [14..15] TCC0.CCA, [16..19] enc1 i32 LE, [20..21] TCF0.CCA velocity, [22] PORTE.IN&0x0F, [23] PORTD.IN, [24..27] msgCNT u32 LE, [28..29] CRC. Matches SADI_FW3.dll mode-1 extract offsets exactly. No state byte, one sample per packet at the programmed loop rate.
